scanNote:
8-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (58-bet).

Yuqorida chapda BINAFShA yorliqda oq '8' va 'A Brush with Danger'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
18) 'Read the questions and circle the correct answers.'
   1 What is a DESERTED BEACH? a an empty beach b a crowded beach
   2 What does SINK mean? a to move slowly upwards b to move slowly downwards
   3 What happens when the tide comes in? a the sea moves up the beach b the sea moves down the beach
   4 What is QUICKSAND? a deep wet sand you sink into as you try to walk on it b sand that moves very fast
19) 'Look at the pictures. How does Ted feel in each one? Underline the correct adjectives.' Picture 1: a excited b sad | Picture 3: a terrified b upset | Picture 4: a angry b frightened | Picture 5: a relieved b anxious
20) 'Read the story and put the paragraphs in the correct order, then explain the words in bold.'
21) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the list of events below, then listen and put the events in the correct order.' Olti voqea nuqtali joylar bilan; 'Ted was walking along the beach' oldida ko'k qiya '1': It started raining. / Steve pulled Ted out of the quicksand. / Ted started sinking into the quicksand. / 1 Ted was walking along the beach. / Steve heard Ted's cries. / Ted shouted for help.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Use the pictures (1-5) and the list of events in Ex. 21 to help you retell the story.'

O'NG USTUN (och ko'k fon, yirtiq qog'oz):
• BESh CHIZMA KADR (yashil raqamli): 1 - sariq futbolkali erkak (Ted) bo'sh plyajda xafa yurmoqda, qora bulutlar; 2 - yomg'ir, Ted mashinasi tomon yugurmoqda; 3 - Ted qumga botmoqda, yomg'ir; 4 - yashil ko'ylakli erkak (Steve) suvda Tedning qo'lidan tortmoqda; 5 - Ted va Steve mashina oldida qo'l berishmoqda.
• Qalin sarlavha 'A Narrow Escape'. Besh xatboshi A-E, katakchali, tartibsiz:
   A - The soft dry sand of the beach SLOWED him DOWN, so he started running on the hard sand at the WATER'S EDGE. Before he had gone fifty metres, though, he suddenly felt himself sinking into the sand. Within seconds, he had sunk in up to his WAIST. He realised to his HORROR that he had STEPPED into quicksand. When he tried to move, the sand pulled him deeper - and the tide was coming in! The water soon covered his CHEST, and continued to rise. "Help!" he shouted DESPERATELY. "Help! I'm going to DROWN!"
   B - Walking to the far end of the beach, Ted was so DEEP IN THOUGHT that he didn't notice the dark clouds which had GATHERED OVERHEAD. When the first heavy DROPS of rain began to fall, he looked up in surprise and hurried back towards his car.
   C - After what had happened, Ted realised that losing a job wasn't the worst thing that could happen to someone. He was glad to be ALIVE, and felt sure that everything would be all right in the end.
   D - The early evening air was cool and MILD as Ted Wilson walked along the ALMOST-DESERTED beach. He wanted to be completely alone to think about his problems. Since he had lost his job, his life seemed to be full of problems.
   E - Steve MacDonald was looking for SHELLS at the other end of the beach when he heard Ted's cries. By the time Steve reached him, the water was up to Ted's CHIN and he was in real danger. Steve GRABBED his arms, pulled him out of the quicksand and helped him to safety. Ted was so RELIEVED to have escaped that he couldn't say a word. He SHOOK STEVE'S HAND, again and again, IN SILENT THANKS.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '58'.

exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni o'qing va to'g'ri javoblarni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNDAN OLDIN - KALIT SO'ZLAR.

  deserted = bo'sh, kimsasiz
  sink = cho'kmoq, botmoq
  the tide comes in = suv
     ko'tariladi
  quicksand = botqoq qum


⚠ 'DESERTED':

  = kimsasiz, tashlab ketilgan.
  ⚠ 'a desert' = cho'l - shu
  so'zdan.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /dɪˈzɜːtɪd/.


⚠ 'TO SINK':

  = cho'kmoq, botmoq.
  ⚠ sink - SANK - SUNK.
  ⚠ 'a sink' (ot) = rakovina.


⚠ 'THE TIDE':

  = suv qalqishi (39-betdagi
  maqolda ham bor edi).
  ⚠ 'the tide comes in' = suv
  ko'tariladi (qirg'oqqa keladi)
  ⚠ 'the tide goes out' = suv
  qaytadi


⚠ 'QUICKSAND':

  = botqoq qum (bosganingizda
  botib ketasiz).
  ⚠ 'quick' bu yerda = tez EMAS,
  eski ma'nosi 'tirik, harakatdagi'.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'UPWARDS' / 'DOWNWARDS':

  = yuqoriga / pastga.
  ⚠ '-wards' = tomon.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. How does Ted feel in each one? Underline the correct adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang. Ted har birida o'zini qanday his qiladi? To'g'ri sifatlar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIS-TUYG'U SIFATLARI.

  Picture 1: SAD (xafa - ishini
     yo'qotgan, yolg'iz yuribdi)
  Picture 3: TERRIFIED (dahshatga
     tushgan - qumga botmoqda)
  Picture 4: FRIGHTENED (qo'rqqan -
     suv iyagigacha)
  Picture 5: RELIEVED (yengil
     tortgan - qutqarildi)


⚠ 'TERRIFIED':

  = dahshatga tushgan (JUDA
  qo'rqqan).
  ⚠ 'frightened' < 'terrified'
  (kuchliroq).
  ⚠ 'terror' = dahshat.


⚠ 'RELIEVED':

  = yengil tortgan (xavf o'tdi).
  ⚠ 'relief' = yengillik.
  ⚠ "What a relief!" = Qanday
  yengillik!


⚠ 'ANXIOUS':

  = tashvishli, xavotirda.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈæŋkʃəs/.


⚠ 'UPSET':

  = xafa, ranjigan.

items.whyUz:
⚠ Qutqarildi - YENGIL TORTGAN.
⚠ Matnda: 'Ted was so RELIEVED'.

exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING TO'LIQ MATNI - TO'G'RI
TARTIBDA (D → B → A → E → C).


⚠ 'A NARROW ESCAPE':

  = arang qutulish (xavfdan zo'rg'a
  qochish).
  ⚠ 'narrow' = tor; 'escape' =
  qochish.


⚠ HIKOYaDA ZAMONLAR:

  PAST SIMPLE - asosiy voqealar
  PAST CONTINUOUS - fon:
    'Steve WAS LOOKING for shells
     when he heard'
    'the tide WAS COMING in'
  PAST PERFECT - oldingi:
    'Since he HAD LOST his job'
    'clouds which HAD GATHERED'
    'Before he HAD GONE fifty metres'
    'he HAD SUNK in up to his waist'
    'he HAD STEPPED into quicksand'
    'After what HAD HAPPENED'

points.en: [D - 1] The early evening air was cool and mild as Ted Wilson walked along the almost-deserted beach. He wanted to be completely alone to think about his problems. Since he had lost his job, his life seemed to be full of problems.
points.uz: [D - 1] Ted Wilson deyarli kimsasiz plyaj bo'ylab yurganida kechki havo salqin va yumshoq edi. U muammolari haqida o'ylash uchun butunlay yolg'iz qolishni xohlardi. Ishini yo'qotganidan beri hayoti muammoga to'la tuyulardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'mild' = yumshoq, mo'tadil (ob-havo).
⚠ 'as' = ... paytida.
⚠ 'Since he HAD LOST' - past perfect.

points.en: [B - 2] Walking to the far end of the beach, Ted was so deep in thought that he didn't notice the dark clouds which had gathered overhead. When the first heavy drops of rain began to fall, he looked up in surprise and hurried back towards his car.
points.uz: [B - 2] Plyajning narigi chekkasiga yurar ekan, Ted shunchalik o'yga botgan ediki, tepasida to'plangan qora bulutlarni sezmadi. Yomg'irning birinchi yirik tomchilari tusha boshlaganda u hayron bo'lib yuqoriga qaradi va mashinasi tomon shoshildi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'so ... that' = shunchalik ... ki.
⚠ 'deep in thought' = o'yga botgan.
⚠ 'to gather' = to'planmoq; 'overhead' = tepada.

points.en: [A - 3] The soft dry sand of the beach slowed him down, so he started running on the hard sand at the water's edge. Before he had gone fifty metres, though, he suddenly felt himself sinking into the sand. Within seconds, he had sunk in up to his waist.
points.uz: [A - 3] Plyajning yumshoq quruq qumi uni sekinlashtirardi, shuning uchun u suv chekkasidagi qattiq qumda yugura boshladi. Lekin ellik metr yurmasidan to'satdan qumga botayotganini sezdi. Bir necha soniyada beligacha botgan edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to slow sb down' = sekinlashtirmoq.
⚠ "the water's edge" = suv chekkasi.
⚠ 'within seconds' = bir necha soniyada.
⚠ 'up to his waist' = beligacha.

points.en: He realised to his horror that he had stepped into quicksand. When he tried to move, the sand pulled him deeper - and the tide was coming in! The water soon covered his chest, and continued to rise. "Help!" he shouted desperately. "Help! I'm going to drown!"
points.uz: U dahshat bilan botqoq qumga qadam qo'yganini angladi. Qimirlamoqchi bo'lganida qum uni chuqurroq tortdi - suv esa ko'tarilayotgan edi! Suv tez orada ko'kragini qopladi va ko'tarilishda davom etdi. "Yordam! - deb qichqirdi u umidsizlik bilan. - Yordam! Cho'kib ketaman!"
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to his horror' = dahshat bilan.
⚠ 'chest' = ko'krak.
⚠ 'desperately' = umidsizlik bilan.
⚠ "I'm going to drown" - ko'rib turgan dalil
asosida taxmin.

points.en: [E - 4] Steve MacDonald was looking for shells at the other end of the beach when he heard Ted's cries. By the time Steve reached him, the water was up to Ted's chin and he was in real danger. Steve grabbed his arms, pulled him out of the quicksand and helped him to safety.
points.uz: [E - 4] Steve MacDonald plyajning narigi chekkasida chig'anoqlar qidirayotgan edi, Tedning qichqiriqlarini eshitdi. Steve yetib borgan paytga kelib suv Tedning iyagigacha chiqqan va u haqiqiy xavfda edi. Steve uning qo'llaridan ushlab, botqoq qumdan tortib chiqardi va xavfsiz joyga olib bordi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'WAS LOOKING ... WHEN he HEARD' - past
continuous + past simple.
⚠ 'chin' = iyak.
⚠ 'to grab' = ushlab olmoq.

points.en: Ted was so relieved to have escaped that he couldn't say a word. He shook Steve's hand, again and again, in silent thanks.
points.uz: Ted qutulganidan shunchalik yengil tortgan ediki, bir og'iz so'z aytolmadi. U jim minnatdorchilik bilan Stevening qo'lini qayta-qayta siqdi.

points.en: [C - 5] After what had happened, Ted realised that losing a job wasn't the worst thing that could happen to someone. He was glad to be alive, and felt sure that everything would be all right in the end.
points.uz: [C - 5] Bo'lib o'tgan voqeadan keyin Ted ishni yo'qotish odam boshiga tushishi mumkin bo'lgan eng yomon narsa emasligini angladi. U tirikligidan xursand edi va oxir-oqibat hammasi yaxshi bo'lishiga ishonardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'losING a job' - gerund ega vazifasida.
⚠ 'the worst' = eng yomon.
⚠ 'would be' - o'tmishdagi kelajak.

TO'G'RI TARTIB: D → B → A → E → C

  1 D - Ted plyajda yuribdi (kirish:

  4 E - Steve eshitadi, qutqaradi

⚠ IShORALAR:

  D birinchi - to'liq ism 'Ted
     Wilson' (birinchi eslatish)
  B - 'hurried back towards his car'
     → A da 'started running'
  A - "I'm going to drown!" → E da
     'heard Ted's cries'
  C oxirgi - 'After what had
     happened' (xulosa)

exercises.exampleEn: Ted was walking along a deserted beach because he had lost his job and wanted to be alone.
exercises.exampleUz: Ted kimsasiz plyaj bo'ylab yurayotgan edi, chunki ishini yo'qotgan va yolg'iz qolishni xohlagan edi.
modelAnswers: Ted was walking along a deserted beach because he had lost his job and wanted to be alone.
Suddenly it started raining, so he hurried back towards his car.
He started running on the hard sand, but he stepped into quicksand and started sinking.
The tide was coming in, and Ted shouted for help.
Steve, who was looking for shells, heard his cries and pulled him out of the quicksand.
Ted was so relieved that he couldn't say a word, and he realised that losing a job wasn't the worst thing in the world.
modelAnswersUz: Ted kimsasiz plyaj bo'ylab yurayotgan edi, chunki ishini yo'qotgan va yolg'iz qolishni xohlagan edi.
To'satdan yomg'ir boshlandi va u mashinasi tomon shoshildi.
U qattiq qumda yugura boshladi, lekin botqoq qumga qadam qo'yib bota boshladi.
Suv ko'tarilayotgan edi va Ted yordam so'rab qichqirdi.
Chig'anoq qidirayotgan Steve uning qichqiriqlarini eshitib, botqoq qumdan tortib chiqardi.
Ted shunchalik yengil tortdiki, bir og'iz so'z aytolmadi va ishni yo'qotish dunyodagi eng yomon narsa emasligini angladi.
